# Tylko & GrowthBook | Potential Scenarios for GB Setup
Date: 2026-11-26 | Duration: 42.09000015258789m

## Summary
The discussion focused on using GrowthBook for e-commerce experimentation while moving from a legacy monolith to commercetools and a composable architecture within months. Existing testing limitations included weak experiment separation, manual randomization, and limited parallel experiments, supporting a build-versus-buy preference with platform support. A phased migration test would keep existing sessions on the legacy platform while routing 10–20% of new sessions to the new experience, initially using a smaller-country pilot with half of new sessions on each platform. Measurement is complicated by two-to-three-week purchase decisions, four or five iterations, and the need to use save-for-later indicators. Routing may use country, recurring-visitor status, basket or session indicators, and login history; anonymous users may lack sufficient information for reassignment. Business users prefer a UI, while CLI, API, MCP, and data-warehouse integrations support automation and analytics. GrowthBook proposed a three-to-four-week Pro trial, with December preferred if engineering resources are available and January as a fallback; Michał will coordinate engineering estimates, while organization setup and cloud or self-hosted selection remain pending.

## Keywords
GrowthBook, A/B testing, Feature flags, E-commerce replatforming, Phased rollout, Proof of concept
